reviews.title: Amazing! Slumber app developers please look at this if you can!
reviews.contents:
I found this app about a month ago (?) and it has been amazing! I fall asleep so fast and my busy brain has nothing to think about while I fall asleep to a comforting voice. I am using and will continue using the free version for a bit, before deciding whether or not to get the premium. I love this app and would like to give you guys some suggestions for tracks.

I love the tracks, but some keep me up because they are so interesting, so I would love if there were some tracks that were repetitive. Something that doesn’t keep my brain awake. I was thinking I would love tracks that repeat a few or one word, like relax, fall asleep or something with that. I love the breathing techniques, so I would absolutely love lots more just breathing, just the narrator doing looped breathing guidance. Short sentences repeated, like ‘you are safe, let calm release’, I would really enjoy it. Repetitive spoken tracks—such as looping phrases, breathing instructions, or repeated calm imagery I would love and would definitely join premium to access them.

Thank you Slumber team for making thousands of people sleep (including me) better. ❤️

reviews.title: The French Whisperer is amazing
reviews.contents: I have been using guided meditation and ASMR for a couple of years. I’m an anxious, fast thinker who is lucky enough to be around in a time of great headphones and great narrators. Two (?) months ago I found this app and it’s better than anything I’ve experienced in an app or on YT. It understands that focus for one person is not focus for another- so has a good range of ‘channels’ - bedtime stories, sounds (ASMR), audiobook etc. However, I am so appreciative of the History channel. Amazing. At first, I admit as an Australian, the accent seemed a bit... much. But this narrator is my favourite ever now. Please, give him more chapters. Dinosaurs is a perfectly crafted narrative and he’s brilliant at delivering it. Cave Art is also awesome for those on the free version. Give him 10 minutes and let the story mature. Hearing him deliver is a gift. I hope this channel grows. Meanwhile, loving the whole depth and breadth of this amazing app. Well done! Sean Maher.

reviews.title: Just for this moment
reviews.contents:
I really enjoyed the just for this moment guided meditation but there is one problem in the of the night l had a bad dream and l had to wake my parents up because l had a bad dream but l was going to do one of the meditations after had nightmares but then l remembered that my parents had put a screen time limit on my iPad they had put it on 10:00 at night till 6:00 in the morning so l could not put the meditation on because l did not know the password only my parents did but l loved the just for this moment guided meditation and tonight l might try  another fantastic meditations.

Thank you so much for making this app l think you made an amazing app thank you again for making this app others will hopefully go to sleep.

I love this app so much, it helps me fall asleep on a school night especially when i wake up at 6:30 to get ready, only a few mins into the sleep tone and I’m dead asleep! But to be honest everything’s locked and I only get 10 dollars for chores, i recommend making some free as some people are not able to afford it and only get a few options to fall asleep too, I really want to listen to the other sounds in the sleep music but over all a great app

reviews.title: More variety of stories and narrators needed
reviews.contents: For the price I have paid for subscription, one would think there would be a larger variety but there isn’t and quite a few of the narrators voices are not calming at all, one seems to bark his stories at you and I cannot listen to any of the stories he reads. It is also possible to speak softly without sounding so bland and monotone, won’t be renewing my subscription. I would rather pay $120 for audio book subscription to over 1000 books, not $87 for a dozen, and from what I’ve seen, since this app came out there’s not a lot of change, different stories each month would be a bonus. Harsh I know, but the price doesn’t match the content.

reviews.title: I’m sleeping!
reviews.contents: This is an excellent app, and I have subscribed to it. There’s a good range to choose from with meditations, stories, and soundscapes. I especially like being able to have background music and soundscapes playing when listening to a meditation, with the option of them finishing a set time after the meditation. The music used is soothing rather than irritating. I am not only sleeping sooner, but am sleeping more deeply with far more pleasant dreams. Very happy!

reviews.title: Slumber
reviews.contents: Best App I have ever bought for Adults and Children alike. The Sleep Stories and Children’s Sleep Stories are without doubt the best. I sleep better than I have in 60 yrs and look forward to going to bed and having his hypnotic voice tell me a story while I drift off. My granddaughter wants to go to bed at night to hear about Malcom the rabbit, and the background music can be extended all night if you prefer.

reviews.title: Fantastic content but needs to improve technology
reviews.contents: I love this app immensely and haven’t slept so well in years. Bethany sending me to sleep as she whispers Leaf in a Stream in my head is my most favourite thing in the world. However the technology is not great - sometimes I can’t download apps, and when I have, they don’t stay downloaded, I have to do that every single night. I paid good money for this app which I was happy to do as it sends me to seep beautifully when it’s working. I shouldn’t have to go to the lounge room to download every night or be reliant on streaming it nightly (I live remotely so my internet is dodgy best of times).

reviews.title: No longer enjoying due to the changes
reviews.contents: Hate the changed format. Very difficult to navigate and find Favourites. The artwork is too much when you are trying to wind down and relax! But mostly looking for the saved stories is now a problem and energy and time consuming. Bring back the old version. If it’s not broken- don’t fix it!

reviews.title: Love
reviews.contents: I love this app. I rarely hear the end of any story. The background noise mixer continues for as long as I need. I have found the right mix to drown hubby snoring. It remembers what mix I like each night except music which I have to slide off EVERY single time. I’ve been a subscriber for months but there has been no new updates for four months. That is disappointing.
